verdicts.typography: Flawless Swiss-style execution. Heading scale is authoritative, mono uppercase labels are perfectly disciplined, line-height and tracking are publication-grade, and the red accent on 'this?' creates exactly the right focal point without breaking restraint.
verdicts.color: Impeccable minimalist discipline. Single restrained red (#D32F2F or similar) used consistently for accents, marks, and active states against near-black/white neutrals. WCAG AA contrast is clearly met. No off-brand colors or visual noise anywhere.
verdicts.layout: Excellent grid alignment and whitespace rhythm throughout. One minor nitpick: in d4-analysis, card 5 ('THE RESULT') has a visible light red background fill that breaks the strict white-canvas consistency of the other four cards—this should be white with only a red left border or text accent to match the system language.
verdicts.components: Publication-grade component quality. The 9-column matrix table uses clear mark semantics (solid red = core, dashed red = partial, hollow = absent), the sticky first column is proven working in d9, accordion affordances are subtle but present (chevrons), stat strip is perfectly balanced, and footer correctly pins to viewport bottom.
verdicts.responsive: Flawless execution across all breakpoints and modes. Mobile layout at 390px maintains perfect integrity with no overflow or clipped text. The wide matrix table handles horizontal scrolling elegantly, including the sticky first-column implementation visible in the scrolled state. Dark mode palette is consistent, utilizing a deep black background with high-contrast white text and distinct red accents that maintain excellent readability.

layout: In the Analysis section (d4-analysis), change card 5 ('THE RESULT') background from light red (#FFF5F5) to pure white (#FFFFFF), keeping only the red left border and/or red uppercase label to maintain visual consistency with cards 1-4.
